2.23.24
Tablix.PageName
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.PageName element specifies the value to use for the name of a paginated page. This
element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section
3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.PageName element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.PageName element.
 <xsd:element name="PageName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
